# descope_flow (Resource)

Manages a single flow in a Descope project via its exported JSON representation, the same format produced by exporting a flow in the Descope console.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (String) The JSON data of the flow in its exported representation, including its metadata, contents, and references. This will usually be exported as a `.json` file from the Descope console, and set in the `.tf` file using the `data = file("...")` syntax.
- `flow_id` (String) The machine identifier of the flow (e.g., `sign-up-or-in`), used to run the flow and to reference it in other resources. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that the flow belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
